f15c474e5-594f-4ab9-954f-9010624068c7.notes: Painted cloth banner on a steel frame over a school wall, Deux Plateaux, Abidjan. Written without accents (MINISTERE, EDUCATION, COLLEGE); apostrophe transcribed as ASCII. The right edge of the photo clips the final S of DAUPHINS and the final E of COLLEGE (both partly visible). This is a postal-box address (06 BP 2445), not a street address.

f6aced74d-85a5-4394-a462-77d9f781f8a4.notes: Two blue street-name blades at a right angle on one pole, Angré, Cocody, Abidjan, seen from below; gold capitals. The 'RUE L54' blade is at a steep angle. Tiny 'VILLE D'ABIDJAN / COMMUNE DE COCODY' crest text is not transcribed. The 'Styliste Modéliste' shop awning at bottom left is a distractor. Alternative query: 'Rue L54'.

f7a8098fa-24e4-48fa-ae05-a15e85ad7060.notes: Blue street-name plate with gold capitals and a gold border, Cocody, Abidjan, slightly from below. The small header 'VILLE D'ABIDJAN' and 'COMMUNE DE COCODY' (split over three lines around the crest) is tiny but legible; the main lines are 'BOULEVARD A5' and 'LATRILLE'. Same blue Cocody style as other Abidjan plates but a different street.

ffdbce8c8-88f4-4275-a7c6-50d15a12046c.notes: Tall totem sign at the roadside, Cocody (university area), Abidjan, slightly from below. Capitals written without accents (NUMERIQUE) while the lowercase lines keep them (Accès, à); apostrophes as ASCII. The initials A and U in AGENCE / UNIVERSITAIRE are picked out in red. The 'SPONSOR OFFICIEL Côte d'Ivoire Telecom' panel at the base is a distractor. Alternative queries: 'Agence universitaire de la Francophonie', 'CURAT'.

c113287726.notes: Hand-painted sign on a wall, Bouaflé: red 'COVIMA' under a logo with a Côte d'Ivoire outline (the logo itself repeats 'CO' and 'IMA'), green slogan with a red arrow. No accent painted on MARAHOUE.

c129499194.notes: Five coloured arrow fingerposts on a yellow pole in Parc National du Banco, Abidjan; read left board then right board, top to bottom. The health slogan board above ('POUR LUTTER CONTRE LE DIABETE ...', 'DON LIONS CLUB COTE D'IVOIRE') and its cut-off 'PARC NATIONAL DU BANCO' header are distractors. Alternative queries: 'Parc National du Banco', 'École Forestière'.

c129501646.notes: 'You are here' board at a trail junction in the forest; small in frame. A crease runs through 'ECOTOURISTIQUE' and 'DU' in the header. The mossy fingerposts below ('SORTIE ESPACE-ECO 2 Km', 'OBSERVEZ LES DIFFERENTS OBSTACLES', 'SORTIE ENTREE ESPACE-ECO') are distractors. Alternative query: 'Carrefour Montagne Martineau'.

c131713818.notes: Black river-name sign with white wave symbol at the Bandama bridge near Tiassalé; close and frontal.

c18601831.notes: Three blue overhead lane signs at Abidjan's Félix Houphouët-Boigny airport: 'P' with subscript 2 and a down arrow, 'AEROGARE DEPART' with two down arrows, 'AUTOCARS' with a diagonal arrow. The terminal lettering behind is hidden by the trees; no-parking pictograms are distractors.

c34834651.notes: Gate lintel of the general hospital, Adiaké, shot from a moving vehicle at an angle with slight motion blur; a red cross precedes 'HOPITAL'. The name is cut at the right edge after 'ADIAK' (full 'D'ADIAKE'). No accents painted.
